set.body:
Hosted studio.yml on 9c4e0cf: RenderFailureCaptureFxSuite 'canvases that exhaust Prism's texture pool' printed no render failure on Linux xvfb or macOS (sw pipeline, scale 1), while local runs always do; it now skips when the pool is not exhausted (0461876). The render-thread capture route (QuantumRenderer, PrintedByToolkit) therefore has no deterministic CI test.

Acceptance: a render-thread fault that reproduces on every pipeline and runner (e.g. a small prism.maxvram in a dedicated forked test config, or another NG-level fault), asserting route PrintedByToolkit on the QuantumRenderer thread, green on hosted Linux and macOS.
set.title: Deterministic render-thread fault for the FX render-failure capture test
